findings.observation: Story and success toasts stack over the monitor heading and current-loop readout for several seconds.
findings.consequence: During the most important causal feedback moment the player temporarily loses the loop and echo readout.
findings.repair: Reserve a notification slot in the left rail or constrain toasts to a lower non-critical zone.

findings.observation: The map schematic compresses a full 15×11 grid into tiny cells; wall and device glyphs are hard to distinguish at 1440.
findings.consequence: The preview reads as atmosphere rather than a usable level overview.
findings.repair: Enlarge the preview or add a readable legend and selected-level highlight.

findings.observation: Several mono micro-labels and control hints sit at 7–10px on a 1440 desktop.
findings.consequence: Secondary readouts demand extra focus and can be skipped despite being relevant.
findings.repair: Raise micro labels one typographic step or offer a UI text scale option.

findings.observation: The map preview and memory shelf follow an eight-row level list; only the sticky enter CTA remains visible.
findings.consequence: Mobile players may enter a level without ever seeing the schematic or memory collection.
findings.repair: Add an optional compact preview above the list or a jump link to details.

largestGap: Toasts temporarily obscure the causality monitor during the strongest causal feedback moments.
nextOperation: Reserve a non-overlapping notification slot and enlarge the archive schematic preview.
regressionCheck: No open P0/P1 findings; desktop and mobile primary actions remain reachable; core state renders correctly.

contract.purpose: Provide a fresh, severity-ranked visual judgment before a meaningful round is accepted.
